column1: This column gives an approximate estimated digestion time range (in hours) for each food item.
Method: estimates are based on general nutrition-science heuristics — food category (beverage, fruit,
grain, legume, fried food, meat, dairy, sweet, etc.) combined with the food's fat, protein, and fibre
content, since higher fat/protein/fibre generally slows gastric emptying and digestion.
- Idli/dosa/appam and other light steamed items: 1.5-2 hours
- Fried foods (vada, bonda, pakora, parotta): 2.5-3.5 hours
IMPORTANT: These are indicative estimates only, NOT clinically measured or lab-verified values.
Actual digestion time varies significantly by individual metabolism, portion size, meal combinations,
cooking method, and overall gut health. Use for general reference/educational purposes only.
